t: What Healthcare Access Database Is All About
title: What Healthcare Access Database Is All About
description: Access is whether care is reachable, affordable, and usable: 100 million people yearly fall into poverty from health costs (WHO); rural Americans drive hours for specialists; wheelchair users find exam tables they can't transfer to. Penchansky's five A's — availability, accessibility, accommodation, affordability, acceptability — frame the problem. Telehealth, mobile clinics, and community health workers extend the map's edges. This database is the complete access record: full records with definitions, key facts, procedures, and runnable demo programs, organized on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced.
definition: Healthcare Access Database: a complete reference database of full access record records.
key_points: What this database holds: full access record records, each with definition, key facts, and a runnable demo program.
